answer_1.quote: PlugIR comprises two key components: context reformulation and context-aware dialogue generation.
answer_1.outputs: generated questions, reformulated captions, filtered non‑redundant questions

answer_3.quote: For each question generated by the questioner, we prompt an LLM agent to respond with "uncertain" if it cannot derive an answer from the corresponding description and dialogue, which implies the question is free from redundancy.

answer_4.quote: We engage 30 human testers to measure human preference for interactive text-to-image retrieval systems... For each instance, human testers are required to answer the following questions: "Q1. The system will be effective... Q2. The system will be efficient..."
answer_4.guideline: Testers rated system effectiveness and efficiency on a Likert scale after reviewing interaction logs.
